name: @Home Network Australia
summary: Australian cable-broadband network operated by the 50/50 joint venture of Cable & Wireless Optus and Excite@Home (June 1999). One /16-scale 1997-era allocation (ATHOME-AU, 203.164.0.0-203.164.255.255). Optus took control of the venture in September 2001 after Excite@Home's US parent collapsed; the service continued under the Optus cable broadband umbrella.

events.details: Cable & Wireless Optus and Excite@Home formed a 50/50 joint venture company to provide @Home cable-broadband services in Australia (Optus media release, June 1999). The network held the ATHOME-AU allocation (203.164.0.0-203.164.255.255).

refs.label: Optus media release (Jun 1999): C&W Optus and Excite@Home form joint venture company

events.details: Optus took control of the Excite@Home Australia venture (Optus media release, Sept 2001) after Excite@Home's US parent collapsed; the cable service continued under the Optus broadband umbrella.

refs.label: Optus media release (Sept 2001): Optus takes control of Excite@Home Australia

events.details: With Optus holding control from Sept 2001 and Excite@Home's US parent in bankruptcy, the joint venture ceased to operate as a distinct entity; the service was absorbed into Optus's cable broadband operation.
